raw_context:
Shoppers Drug Mart faces major legal action regarding a proposed class-action lawsuit filed by former franchise-owning pharmacists, alleging unsafe corporate practices, profit-driven prescription quotas, and professional conflicts of interest. This follows a long-standing multi-million dollar franchise dispute (_Spina v. Shoppers Drug Mart_) over professional allowances and agreement terms. [](https://www.paliareroland.com/our-expertise/class-actions-lawsuits/franchise-dispute--spina-et-al.-v.-shoppers-drug-mart-inc.-(ontario-proceeding--national-class-excluding-quebec))

Filed in the Ontario Superior Court of Justice, this proposed class action targets Shoppers Drug Mart and its parent company, Loblaw. [](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/loblaw-shoppers-face-possible-suit-5983044/)

- **The Allegations:** The suit claims corporate policies force pharmacist-owners into an "irredeemable conflict of interest" between patient safety and company profit. [](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/alyhaji_proposed-class-action-lawsuit-against-shoppers-activity-7186194616080064513-BuE2)

- **Quotas and Targets:**

It alleges management enforces strict, arbitrary targets for MedsCheck reviews, minor ailment prescriptions, and vaccinations.

[](https://globalnews.ca/news/10429363/shoppers-drug-mart-lawsuit-pharmacists/)

- **Retaliation Claims:** The filing asserts that owners face public "naming and shaming" or abrupt, humiliating agreement terminations if they miss targets or speak out about safety concerns. [](https://www.ctvnews.ca/toronto/article/proposed-class-action-lawsuit-against-shoppers-drug-mart-alleges-unsafe-and-unethical-corporate-practices/)

- **Company Response:** Loblaw and Shoppers Drug Mart have stated the case has no merit and vowed a vigorous defense. [](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/loblaw-shoppers-face-possible-suit-5983044/)

### The Long-Running Franchise Dispute (_Spina v. Shoppers_)

A separate, massive multi-million dollar class action involving nearly 1,500 current and former associate-owners (excluding Quebec) has worked its way through Ontario courts. [](https://www.paliareroland.com/our-expertise/class-actions-lawsuits/franchise-dispute--spina-et-al.-v.-shoppers-drug-mart-inc.-(ontario-proceeding--national-class-excluding-quebec))

- **Financial Claims:** Franchisees alleged that the corporate entity breached associate agreements by retaining and misallocating professional allowances (amounting to hundreds of millions of dollars) and overcharging for store fees and equipment. [](https://www.paliareroland.com/our-expertise/class-actions-lawsuits/franchise-dispute--spina-et-al.-v.-shoppers-drug-mart-inc.-(ontario-proceeding--national-class-excluding-quebec))

- **Legal Status:** The litigation has seen various procedural battles and appellate decisions addressing the scope of the claims and the duty of good faith. [](https://www.sotosllp.com/2024/10/17/a-prescription-for-good-faith-the-court-of-appeals-decision-in-spina-v-shoppers-drug-mart/)
